parameters.query:
-- Look up products matching the customer's query (§10.2 Node 1)
-- Searches by name (full-text) or category entity extracted from classifier
SELECT
  id, name, description, price, category, stock, variants, image_url, tags
FROM products
WHERE
  business_id = '{{ $json.business_id }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND (
    -- match by category entity (exact)
    category ILIKE '{{ $json.entities?.product_category ?? '' }}'
    -- OR full-text match on name
    OR to_tsvector('english', name) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', '{{ (typeof $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText === 'string' ? $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}')
    -- OR tag match
    OR '{{ (typeof $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText === 'string' ? $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}' = ANY(tags)
  )
ORDER BY
  -- Boost exact name matches
  CASE WHEN name ILIKE '%' || '{{ (typeof $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText === 'string' ? $json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText.replace(/'/g, "''") : JSON.stringify($json.entities?.product_name ?? $json.messageText).replace(/'/g, "''")) }}' || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  -- Then by best seller tags
  CASE WHEN 'best seller' = ANY(tags) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 3;

nodes.notes: Full-text search + category + tag match. Returns top 3 results.
